scene.ko: 독서 모임에서 만난 사람에게 전화해서 전에 말한 커피 약속의 날짜와 장소를 정한다.

lines.en: Hi, Chloe? It's Minho, from the book club.
lines.ko: 안녕하세요, 클로이 씨? 독서 모임에서 만난 민호예요.
alt: Hi, is this Chloe? This is Minho from the book club.
Hey, Chloe. It's Minho. We met at the book club.

lines.en: Oh, hi, Minho! Good to hear from you.
lines.ko: 아, 안녕하세요, 민호 씨! 연락 줘서 반가워요.

lines.en: I was wondering if you'd like to get that coffee we talked about.
lines.ko: 지난번에 얘기했던 커피, 같이 마시면 어떨까 해서요.
alt: I wanted to see if you're still up for that coffee.
Would you still like to get coffee sometime this week?

lines.en: I'd love to! When are you free?
How about Wednesday after work? Around seven?
alt: Does Wednesday evening work for you? Maybe around seven?
Are you free on Wednesday at seven?

lines.en: Wednesday works. Where should we meet?
There's a nice café near Hapjeong Station. I'll send you the location.
lines.ko: 합정역 근처에 괜찮은 카페가 있어요. 위치 보내 드릴게요.
alt: I know a nice café by Hapjeong Station. I'll text you the address.

expressions.en: I was wondering if you'd like to ___.

expressions.note: 제안한 시간이 괜찮을 때 · 물을 땐 Does ___ work for you?
